tools.name: accuranker_list_accounts
tools.description: List the AccuRanker accounts the token can read (id and name). Use it first to confirm the connection. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/accounts/.

tools.name: accuranker_list_domains
tools.description: List tracked domains with their daily history (average rank, share of voice, traffic value, search volume) for a date range. Good first call to find a domain id. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/domains/.

tools.name: accuranker_get_domain
tools.description: Get one tracked domain by id with its daily history for a date range (KPIs such as average rank and share of voice). AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/domains/{id}/.

tools.name: accuranker_list_keywords
tools.description: List the keywords tracked for one domain, with rank history for a date range (rank, estimated visits, share of voice). Use it to find a keyword id. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/domains/{domain_pk}/keywords/.

tools.name: accuranker_get_keyword
tools.description: Get one tracked keyword of a domain by id, with its rank history for a date range. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/domains/{domain_pk}/keywords/{id}/.

tools.name: accuranker_search_keywords
tools.description: Find keywords of one domain that match filters, for example rank below 10 or a keyword that contains a word. Send a flat list of filters joined by one operator. Filter names come from accuranker_list_filters. Read only: the request body only selects data. AccuRanker Read API: POST /api/v4/domains/{d

tools.name: accuranker_list_landing_pages
tools.description: List the landing pages of one domain with their history (average rank, share of voice, traffic value, keywords) for a date range. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/domains/{domain_pk}/landing_pages/.

tools.name: accuranker_list_tags
tools.description: List the keyword tags of one domain with their history (average rank, share of voice, traffic value, keywords) for a date range. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/domains/{domain_pk}/tags/.

tools.name: accuranker_list_segments
tools.description: List the saved segments (saved filter sets) this token can apply, with their filters. Pass a segment id as segment_id to other tools. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/segments/.

tools.name: accuranker_list_filters
tools.description: List every filter name usable in accuranker_search_keywords, with its value type, allowed comparators and allowed values. AccuRanker Read API: GET /api/v4/filters/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: accuranker_search_keywords · Private data: accuranker_list_accounts, accuranker_list_segments · Public sink: accuranker_list_domains, accuranker_get_domain, accuranker_list_keywords, accuranker_search_keywords, accuranker_list_landing_pages, accuranker_list_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: accuranker_search_keywords · Private data: accuranker_list_accounts, accuranker_list_segments · Public sink: accuranker_list_domains, accuranker_get_domain, accuranker_list_keywords, accuranker_search_keywords, accuranker_list_landing_pages, accuranker_list_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
